description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'AdminController' that manages administrative user operations such as adding new users. It includes request mappings for displaying the user addition form and processing form submissions, utilizing dependency-injected services and repositories.

classes.name: AdminController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling administrative user management functions, including displaying the add user form and processing user creation submissions.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the form for adding a new user, populating the model with necessary data such as roles, users, and offices.

methods.name: registerUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process the submitted user creation form, validating input and saving the new user if valid.
